messages:
maria: FYI I ran into a support ticket where a user hit a 400 because their webhook payload referenced an old model alias. The error message returned by the API is fine, but our docs still show the alias in the webhook example. Need a short patch to the migration guide and the webhook tutorial.

maria: Example snippet (from tutorial):

maria: ```
POST /webhook
{
  "model_alias": "rwd-similarity",
  "input": "hello"
}
```

emma: Oof. We should avoid encouraging aliases in examples unless we show how to map them. Proposal: convert tutorial to use explicit model names and add a callout block explaining alias -> model mapping and how to opt in to alias compatibility in Dedicated.

kevin: Agree. I'll add a compatibility note to the migration guide showing the mapping table, plus a short curl example using the v2 body: 

kevin: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd/similarity-v2","input":"hello"}'
```

zara: Also we should make a redirect plan: if we rename anchors or add new sections, include a short redirect note in the docs repo so old links used by integration guides don't 404. We have a tiny redirects.json in the docs site config. Maria, can you update that?

maria: Yes. I'll add an anchor named #alias-mapping and add a redirect mapping from /tutorials/webhooks#model_alias to /migration/v1-to-v2#alias-mapping. I'll include a brief blurb for Dedicated customers about alias compatibility mode and how to enable it.

kevin: For the SDK snippets: we should avoid using alias strings in the top-level code samples. I'll open a separate PR in the examples repo to replace occurrences and leave a TODO comment explaining why. We should also add a tiny test that greps examples for "model_alias" and fails CI so we don't reintroduce it later.

emma: Good call on the test. Where should that live? docs CI or examples CI? I think examples CI makes sense since that's the repo where the examples live. If it fails there, we can coordinate a quick backport patch.

zara: I'll coordinate with infra to add a docs webhook that alerts the docs channel if redirects.json changes. It will help us keep the redirect mappings in sync during releases.

maria: Plan: 1) docs PR to update webhook tutorial + migration guide + redirects.json, 2) examples PR to replace alias snippets and add grep test, 3) CLI/SDK PRs if any code paths still print examples with aliases, 4) changelog entry under "docs" so PMs can call out the change.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4678 - title: "docs: replace model_alias examples with v2 model names; add alias-mapping anchor" (assignee: maria)

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/322 - title: "examples: remove model_alias usage; add grep test" (assignee: kevin)

release-bot: release note draft updated: "Docs: tutorial webhook examples now use explicit v2 model names; alias mapping added to migration guide (link)."

kevin: ETA on examples PR: I'm working on test now, should be ready in a few hours. I'll link both PRs in the release note so docs + examples land before the next release.

maria: I'll include the redirect entry and anchor name in the docs PR description so the release script picks it up. Also adding a short troubleshooting line to migration guide: "If you see errors referencing model_alias in payloads, convert to the v2 model name or enable alias compatibility on Dedicated."

emma: Perfect. Once both PRs pass CI, ping me and we'll merge together and ship the docs update.

kevin: CI started on examples PR #322

docs-bot: CI passed for docs PR #4678

kevin: CI passed for examples PR #322

release-bot: All checks green. Scheduling docs release window for later today.

maria: Merged docs PR and added redirect mapping. Thanks everyone.

emma: Thanks! Small but important cleanup.
__metadata_note: Per agents.md: fields are strings or list of strings. Message text is a single continuous thread string. No title field included.
